about_the_game:
The rules of chess have been broken.

Victory is no longer decided by a single, careful move, but by split-second decisions and god-like control. Mechanical Chess is a fast and furious real-time chess that has thrown off the shackles of turn-based gameplay.

Forget taking turns. In Mechanical Chess, every piece moves in real-time at your command. The strategic depth of chess collides with the intense micro-control of an RTS. Control multiple pieces at once to flank your opponent, dodge incoming attacks with lightning-fast reflexes, and shatter their king's defense before they can react.

Key Features

INTENSE REAL-TIME PVP: Forget turns, and test your mechanics against players from around the world. There is only skill.

CHALLENGING SINGLE-PLAYER: Hone your strategies against a variety of AI opponents and conquer a series of unique campaign missions.

CLIMB THE GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Win matches, increase your ELO rating, and see how you stack up against the very best under your banner of Gambit Forge.

STRATEGY MEETS ACTION: Experience the timeless depth of chess fused with the adrenaline-pumping, moment-to-moment gameplay of a real-time strategy game.

From solo developer Gambit Forge, this game was forged with a passion for chess and a love for action-strategy games. We look forward to seeing you on the new battlefield!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 630 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB GB available space

short_description: "Who wins: a chess grandmaster's strategy or a pro-gamer's reflexes?" In Mechanical Chess, you need both. Shattering the old rules, we've removed turns for pure real-time battles. Your mind is the strategist, your hands are the weapon. Enter the arena and prove your mastery!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
